display.purpose: Selected horse name and program number. Extra-condensed athletic gothic, uppercase, leading under 0.8.

headline.purpose: MARKETO wordmark; smaller than the selected horse. Slip and Enter titles share the family at 800.

title.purpose: Program-strip names, picked-horse line, enter-form values.

body.purpose: Markets line, slip lead, notes. Short measure, not a 65ch column.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked captions, chips, Connect, PP headers.

motion.name: stamp-press
motion.purpose: Deposit stamp hover/focus: contrast(1.12) brightness(0.96). Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

breakpoints.name: sheet-stack
breakpoints.purpose: Masthead, fold, call, program, and enter grids collapse to one column. Call rule moves from right to bottom.

components.name: Connect Button
components.description: Ink-fill wallet gate and Open vault. Not the Deposit action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #040303; color: #f3eadc; padding: 0.35rem 0.55rem; border: 2px solid #040303; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.8rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #040303; color: #f3eadc; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #040303; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #040303; }

components.name: Amount Chip
components.description: Slip amount adder. Transparent ink box; hover inverts.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.35rem; } .ds-chip { padding: 0.15rem 0.45rem; border: 1px solid #040303; background: transparent; color: #040303; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-chip:hover { background: #040303; color: #f3eadc; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #040303; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-chip:active { background: #040303; color: #f3eadc; }

components.name: Underline Field
components.description: Amount and enter-form fields: no box, 3px ink underline, athletic figures.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.2rem; } .ds-field-label { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #040303; } .ds-input-underline { width: 100%; border: 0; border-bottom: 3px solid #040303; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; padding: 0.2rem 0; color: #040303; font-family: 'Big Shoulders Display', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-size: 2.6rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.03em; line-height: 1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-input-underline:hover { border-bottom-color: #040303; } .ds-input-underline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #040303; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Market Silks
components.description: Square BTC red / ETH blue identity. Market letters, never a coin logo.
components.css: .ds-silks-row { display: flex; gap: 0.75rem; align-items: center; } .ds-silks { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 3.4rem; height: 3.4rem; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Big Shoulders Display', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.05rem; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: #f3eadc; } .ds-silks-btc { background: #e42c22; } .ds-silks-eth { background: #0756d0; }

components.name: SYNTHETIC Tag
components.description: Inverted condition stamp for figures that are not on-chain.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; padding: 0 0.28rem; background: #040303; color: #f3eadc; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.8rem; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Betting Slip
components.description: BACK THIS HORSE panel. Hot Sheet wash, boxed title, dashed shares strip.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-slip { padding: 1rem 1.1rem 1.2rem; background: color-mix(in srgb, #f3eadc 55%, transparent); color: #040303; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; } .ds-slip-title { margin: 0; padding: 0.25rem 0.4rem; border: 3px solid #040303; font-family: 'Big Shoulders Display', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.7rem; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1; text-align: center; } .ds-picked { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.55rem; margin: 0.8rem 0; padding-bottom: 0.55rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #040303; } .ds-picked strong { font-family: 'Big Shoulders Display', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-size: 1.6rem; line-height: 0.9; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-silks-sm { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 2.1rem; height: 2.1rem; background: #e42c22; color: #f3eadc; font-family: 'Big Shoulders Display', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 0.7rem; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-strip { margin: 0; padding: 0.4rem 0.45rem; border: 1px dashed #040303; } .ds-strip dt { margin: 0; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-strip dd { margin: 0.15rem 0 0; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.25rem; color: #085324; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-tag { padding: 0 0.28rem; background: #040303; color: #f3eadc; letter-spacing: 0.12em; }

components.name: Program Entry
components.description: Unselected horse on the program strip. Ink wash when hovered or pressed.
components.css: .ds-entry { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 0.45rem 0.65rem; align-items: center; width: 100%; padding: 0.7rem 0.9rem; border: 0; border-right: 1px solid #040303; background: transparent; color: #040303; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; } .ds-entry:hover, .ds-entry:active { background: color-mix(in srgb, #040303 8%, transparent); } .ds-entry:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #040303; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-entry-num { font-family: 'Big Shoulders Display', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 900; font-size: 2rem; line-height: 0.8; } .ds-silks-entry { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 2rem; height: 2rem; background: #0756d0; color: #f3eadc; font-family: 'Big Shoulders Display', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 0.68rem; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-entry-name { display: block; font-family: 'Big Shoulders Display', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.7rem; line-height: 0.85; letter-spacing: -0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-pedigree { display: block; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-entry-purse { font-weight: 700; color: #085324; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: right; }

components.name: Deposit Stamp
components.description: Primary deposit action: distressed green rubber stamp, multiplied onto the sheet. Not an ink-fill button.
components.css: .ds-stamp { display: block; width: min(100%, 22rem); margin: 0.2rem auto 0; padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; color: #085324; } .ds-stamp-face { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.55rem; padding: 0.85rem 1.1rem; border: 4px solid #085324; outline: 2px solid #085324; outline-offset: -8px; transform: rotate(-6deg); font-family: 'Big Shoulders Display', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; } .ds-stamp-type { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; line-height: 1; } .ds-stamp-type strong { font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } .ds-stamp-type small { margin-top: 0.25rem; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.14em; } .ds-star { width: 1.1rem; height: 1.1rem; fill: #085324; } .ds-stamp:hover .ds-stamp-face, .ds-stamp:focus-visible .ds-stamp-face { filter: contrast(1.12) brightness(0.96); } .ds-stamp:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #040303; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-stamp .ds-stamp-face { transition: filter 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); }

components.name: Locale Toggle
components.description: Masthead locale. Underlined until pressed; active fills ink.
components.css: .ds-locale { display: flex; gap: 0.35rem; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } .ds-locale-btn { background: none; border: 0; padding: 0.15rem 0.2rem; color: #040303; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 0; } .ds-locale-btn.is-active, .ds-locale-btn[aria-pressed='true'] { text-decoration: none; background: #040303; color: #f3eadc; } .ds-locale-btn:hover:not(.is-active):not([aria-pressed='true']) { text-decoration-thickness: 2px; } .ds-locale-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #040303; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
Marketo reads as a Daily Racing Form card, not as a dark trading terminal. The sheet is ink on warm newsprint: extra-condensed athletic gothic for names and numbers, agate condensed for the small type that handicappers actually read, and thick rules that cut the page into a masthead, a call, a betting slip, and a program. Heroes are horses. BTC and ETH are silks. The vault is a purse. Deposit is a rubber stamp pressed into the slip.

The product commitment is an arena of heroes fighting a market. This world keeps that fight and casts it as a past-performance page you can study, back, or enter. A disconnected visitor stays a spectator of the card until they sign. Figures that are not on-chain wear an inverted SYNTHETIC stamp so the sheet never impersonates a live tote.
keyCharacteristics: Warm newsprint ground, hue-less fiber tiled and multiplied into the sheet
Big Shoulders Display for the call; Barlow Condensed for agate
Square-cut everything; 3px carbon-ink rules between major regions
Red BTC / blue ETH silks squares as identity, not portraits
Purse green only for money in the black and for the Deposit stamp
Invert-to-ink as the selected / pressed language

rules.name: The Silks Rule
rules.body: BTC is always the red square; ETH is always the blue square. Silks are filled squares of extra-condensed market letters in Hot Sheet. They carry identity. Do not substitute coin logos, gradients, or circular avatars.

rules.name: The Purse-Green Rule
rules.body: Green is for vault figures, winning PnL, and the Deposit stamp. Losing PnL prints in Carbon Ink. Do not use green for “go,” links, or decorative fills.

rules.name: The Call-is-Bigger Rule
rules.body: The selected horse name outranks MARKETO. Product chrome never out-shouts the horse you are looking at.

rules.name: The Agate Rule
rules.body: Past performances, chips, locale, and captions set in Barlow Condensed. Big Shoulders is for names, program numbers, purses, and keyed-in amounts only.

rules.name: The Ruled-Sheet Rule
rules.body: New regions join the card with a 3px ink rule, not a card-in-a-card, not a shadow, not extra outer margin. Hairlines are for rows inside a region.

rules.name: The Pressed-Ink Rule
rules.body: If something needs to sit “on” the sheet, multiply it or wash it. Do not raise it.

rules.name: The Square-Cut Rule
rules.body: Radius is always 0. Pills, squircles, and rounded fields are off the card.

dos: Do ground new surfaces on Sheet Stock with the newsprint tile at 240px, `background-blend-mode: multiply`.
Do cut regions with 3px Carbon Ink rules and keep every radius at 0.
Do identify a market with silks squares (BTC red, ETH blue) and extra-condensed letters.
Do print purses and winning PnL in Purse Green; print losses in Carbon Ink.
Do set horse names and program numbers in Big Shoulders Display 800–900; set tables, labels, and notes in Barlow Condensed.
Do invert to ink-on-Hot-Sheet for selection, chip hover, and active locale.
Do mark non-chain figures with the inverted SYNTHETIC tag.
donts: Don't ship a dark DeFi hero with three equal feature cards.
Don't round corners, raise shadows, or frost glass over the sheet.
Don't give heroes photographic portraits or coin-logo avatars; silks carry identity.
Don't recast BTC as orange or ETH as purple; those silks are locked.
Don't use Purse Green for losses, links, or large fills that are not money or the stamp.
Don't let MARKETO or UI labels out-size the selected horse name on a call surface.
Don't swap the Deposit stamp for a gradient CTA or a second ink-fill button.
Don't substitute Inter, system UI, or a serif editorial face for the athletic gothic / agate pairing.
